subject: Medicore: on-prem licensing & support tier breakdown
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@medicore.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Medicore: initial on-prem pricing summary and next steps

Elena —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation I pulled together a concise breakdown for a Medicore on-prem (VPC) deployment so your procurement team can evaluate cost and contract structure. Attached: a one-page SOW draft and an itemized quote workbook that shows the amortized platform fee vs. upfront model. High level:

- Dedicated VPC licensing (per-GPU seat model) + 3rd-party OS/infra not included
- Platform fee: annual platform control plane + support entitlement (we can amortize over the commitment length)
- Support tiers: Standard (business hours, 4hr P1), Premium (24/7, 1hr P1), and Enterprise (n+1 on-call + quarterly architecture reviews)

Two asks for you:
1) Confirm which support tier Procurement would prefer (Standard / Premium / Enterprise)
2) If you have an internal preferred PO cadence (annual vs. multi-year) so we can show committed pricing with a 3-year amortization option

If helpful, I can schedule a 30-minute call with Karthik (infra lead) and Marissa (commercial) tomorrow to walk through the quote line items.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
--
Attachments: Medicore_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF, 1 page), redwood-platform-quote-20260914.xlsx (XLSX, 4 sheets)
From: Elena Park <elena.park@medicore.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Medicore Procurement <procurement@medicore.com>, Timothy Shaw <tshaw@medicore.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Medicore: initial on-prem pricing summary and next steps

Jordan —

Thanks for the detailed packet. A few clarifying items from procurement and IT:

- Platform fee: can you show the math if we spread the platform fee across 3 years vs 1 year?
- Onboarding / migration credit: our CFO is asking whether you provide any upfront credits tied to a multi-year commitment (3 years preferred)
- Support: Procurement leans to Premium but wants a 15% discount on the support line for the first year
- Compliance: can you confirm if SOC2 evidence and an annual penetration-test report are included with Enterprise support?

We can do a call Friday morning if that helps.

Elena
VP IT Operations | Medicore Health
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Medicore procurement questions — quick internal alignment

Team — forwarding procurement questions from Medicore. Key asks: amortize platform fee (1 vs 3 years), onboarding credit for multiyear commit, 15% off Premium support year 1, SOC2/pen-test clarifications. Notes and proposed responses below — pls weigh in quickly as they want a call Friday.

Karthik: can you provide a clear line-item showing platform fee amortization (1yr, 2yr, 3yr) and whether we need to change the SKU for a 3yr commit? Also confirm whether SOC2 artifacts / pen-test summary can be shared under an NDA as part of Enterprise.

Grace / Marissa: commercial ask — we typically reserve onboarding credits for committed seats > X and for >24 month deals. Can we flex for 3yr deals? If so, how much of a one-time credit can we offer without needing leadership approval?

Quick thoughts: I think we can offer a 10% onboarding credit + 10% discount on platform fee year 1 for a signed 3-year term; procurement is asking for 15% on support, which may be doable if we limit to year 1 only and route to Premium.

Jordan
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Medicore procurement questions — quick internal alignment

Jordan / team —

I attached a quick amortization snapshot (pasted below in the call so they have visibility). Short answer: we can present three price profiles in the quote workbook: 1yr, 2yr, 3yr. For 3yr commit we lock platform-fee SKU at a reduced annual rate; technically no SKU change required, we model as a committed discount.

SOC2/pen-test: we can share SOC2 Type II summary report and an executive pen-test summary under NDA. Full test reports and raw findings require legal/infosec sign-off but are typically available during procurement review. Enterprise includes an annual pen-test summary; confirm with Elena whether she needs the full report.

On support discounts: technical impact is nil; discounts are commercial. For a 3yr commit we can support 15% off Premium year 1 if commercial approves; otherwise 10% is the typical cap without VP sign-off.

Karthik

-- amortization snippet to paste on call --
Platform fee (base): $450,000/year
1-yr effective platform fee: $450,000
3-yr amortized effective platform fee: $350,000/year (includes 10% committed discount + amortized onboarding credit)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@medicore.com>
Cc: Medicore Procurement <procurement@medicore.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Medicore: on-prem pricing & support — 3-year profile and draft SOW

Elena —

Thanks for the clarity. Attached is an updated quote workbook with three pricing profiles (1yr / 2yr / 3yr) and a revised SOW that includes the onboarding credit language. Highlights:

- 3-year option: platform fee reduced to $350k/year (reflects committed discount + amortized onboarding credit)
- Onboarding credit: one-time credit equal to 10% of year-1 platform fee applied against invoice at project milestone completion
- Support: Premium tier at list price with a 15% discount applied for year 1 only (we cap discounts to year 1 for longer commitments)
- Compliance: SOC2 Type II summary and pen-test executive summary will be provided under NDA; full pen-test requires additional redaction/infosec approval

Next steps: can your procurement team confirm acceptance of the 3-year profile and we’ll circulate a DocuSign for the 3yr SOW + MSA? I’ve also included a link to the HubSpot deal for reference.

Best,
Jordan
--

Subject: Re: Medicore: on-prem pricing & support — 3-year profile and draft SOW

Jordan / team —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Procurement reviewed the 3-year profile and can accept the platform fee and onboarding credit as drafted. A couple of final asks before we route to legal:

- Please include a one-sentence SLA carve-out in the SOW that defines remediation credits for sustained P2/P1 incidents (we will provide language if helpful)
- Confirm that the SOC2 summary and pen-test executive summary will be attached to the procurement package under NDA prior to signature

If you can add the SLA sentence and re-send the DocuSign by EOD Wednesday we will aim to run to signature the following week.

Thanks,
Elena Park
VP IT Operations | Medicore Health
